shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright monolithic form
anthropomorphic/zoomorphic figures in relief on a monument surface
horizontal banded register across the middle of the surface
arm/limb elements rendered in shallow relief wrapping the body
repeated small figures in a row along the upper part
justification: Both are massive upright pillar-like carved surfaces bearing very low, flat relief organized into an upper zone of small repeated figures/motifs and a horizontal banded belt across the middle, with a disc-like element and limb-like ridges below — a loosely comparable scheme of a monolith treated as a schematic body. But the specific content differs: A shows a row of arched animal forms, birds and quadrupeds in profile plus a snake and chevron patterning, while B is a single frontal humanoid figure with a headdress, chest ornament and belt, and none of A's identifiable animals recur.
